blb.text: In Goodhill, Mabel's birthday is interrupted when Jenefer reports a stranger in Pond Creek, and Mabel grabs her rapier and takes the collapsed Helga home, saying her party will have to wait.
Helga wakes in Mabel's house and tells of Maha's attack and the destruction of Pondside, but Mayor Oliver doubts her and reassures the guests that Calamity Beasts do not trouble the Valley.

Mabel believes Helga, takes her family's fang-sword from the attic, and at the party publicly defends her and announces she will go to Pondside, where Finneas, Hugs, Gev, Zoraline and Helga volunteer to join her.
After the party sets out from Goodhill, the returning heroes are welcomed with a parade, and Helga decides to stay in Goodhill as a hedgewitch.
